---
title: "4 Assess methodological practice"
link-citations: true
---

## Definition
These studies aim to describe the use of methods in practice, often with an intention to highlight good or poor practice.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal" collapse="true"}
## Boundaries with related objectives
[14 Assess variability of results across methodological choices](14variability.qmd): O4 describes which methods researchers use in practice, whereas O14 quantifies how much results change when those choices vary.
:::

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples
[Quantitative surveys](../approaches/6survey.qmd): assess current practice of involving patients in statistical research.[@Abell2023incorporation]

[Qualitative studies](../approaches/7qualitative.qmd): interviews to understand the reasons for non-reporting of outcomes.[@Smyth2011frequency]

[Reviews of applied or planned methods](../approaches/9review-applied.qmd): quality and reporting of prediction models for COVID-19;[@Wynants2020prediction] construction and application of directed acyclic graphs in leading medical journals.[@Deng2026construction]
